arxiv-1705-00298.title: Reconstructing a Lattice Equation: a Non-Autonomous Approach to the Hietarinta Equation This paper is a contribution to the Special Issue on Symmetries and Integrability of Difference Equations. The full collection is available at http://www.emis.de/journals/SIGMA/SIDE12.html
arxiv-1705-00298.creator: Giorgio GUBBIOTTI †‡ and Christian SCIMITERNA ‡
arxiv-1705-00298.description: Abstract In this paper we construct a non-autonomous version of the Hietarinta equation [Hietarinta J., J. Phys. A: Math. Gen. 37 (2004), L67–L73] and study its integrability properties. We show that this equation possess linear growth of the degrees of iterates, generalized symmetries depending on arbitrary functions, and that it is Darboux integrable.

arxiv-1912-12592.title: Spectrum of the strange hidden charm molecular pentaquarks in chiral effective field theory
arxiv-1912-12592.creator: Bo Wang 1,2, Lu Meng 2, Shi-Lin Zhu 2,1
arxiv-1912-12592.description: Abstract We calculate the effective potentials of the Ξ c ​ D ¯ ( ∗ ) \Xi_{c}\bar{D}^{(\ast)} , Ξ c ′ ​ D ¯ ( ∗ ) \Xi_{c}^{\prime}\bar{D}^{(\ast)} and Ξ c ∗ ​ D ¯ ( ∗ ) \Xi_{c}^{\ast}\bar{D}^{(\ast)} systems with the chiral effective field theory up to the next-to-leading order. We simultaneously consider the short-, intermediate- and long-range interactions.

arxiv-2010-07686.title: Critical elliptic equations on non-compact Finsler manifolds
arxiv-2010-07686.creator: Csaba Farkas
arxiv-2010-07686.description: Abstract . In the present paper we deal with a quasilinear elliptic equation involving a critical Sobolev exponent on non-compact Randers spaces. Under very general assumptions on the perturbation, we prove the existence of a non-trivial solution. The approach is based on the direct methods of the calculus of variations.

arxiv-2105-07384.title: CONTROLLABILITY NEAR A HOMOCLINIC BIFURCATION
arxiv-2105-07384.creator: Fritz Colonius Institute of Mathematics, University of Augsburg, Augsburg, Germany, Amani Hasan School of Mathematics, Statistics, and Computer Science, College of Science, University of Tehran, Iran & Faculty of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Damascus University, Syria, Gholam Reza Rokni La
arxiv-2105-07384.description: Abstract Abstract: Controllability properties are studied for control-affine systems depending on a parameter \alpha and with constrained control values. The uncontrolled systems in dimension two and three are subject to a homoclinic bifurcation. This generates two families of control sets depending on a parameter in the involved vector fields and the size of the control range.

arxiv-2106-14255.title: On Graphical Models and Convex Geometry
arxiv-2106-14255.creator: Haim Y. Bar, Martin T. Wells
arxiv-2106-14255.description: Abstract We introduce a mixture-model of beta distributions to identify significant correlations among P P predictors when P P is large. The method relies on theorems in convex geometry, which we use to show how to control the error rate of edge detection in graphical models.

arxiv-2112-05746.title: On Causally Disentangled Representations
arxiv-2112-05746.creator: Abbavaram Gowtham Reddy, Benin Godfrey L, Vineeth N Balasubramanian
arxiv-2112-05746.description: Abstract Representation learners that disentangle factors of variation have already proven to be important in addressing various real world concerns such as fairness and interpretability. Initially consisting of unsupervised models with independence assumptions, more recently, weak supervision and correlated features have been explored, but without a causal view of the generative process.

arxiv-2204-01836.title: Decoherence and classicalization of continuous-time quantum walks on graphs Journal: Quantum Information Processing
arxiv-2204-01836.creator: Gabriele Bressanini, Claudia Benedetti, Matteo G. A. Paris
arxiv-2204-01836.description: Abstract We address decoherence and classicalization of continuous-time quantum walks (CTQWs) on graphs. In particular, we investigate three different models of decoherence, and employ the quantum-classical (QC) dynamical distance as a figure of merit to assess whether, and to which extent, decoherence classicalizes the CTQW, i.e. turns it into the analogue classical process.

arxiv-2206-09478.title: Charge-to-spin conversion in twisted graphene/ WSe 2 \textrm{WSe}_{2} heterostructures
arxiv-2206-09478.creator: Seungjun Lee, D. J. P. de Sousa, Young-Kyun Kwon, Fernando de Juan, Zhendong Chi, Fèlix Casanova, Tony Low
arxiv-2206-09478.description: Abstract We investigate the twist angle dependence of spin-orbit coupling (SOC) proximity effects and charge-to-spin conversion (CSC) in graphene/ WSe 2 \textrm{WSe}_{2} heterostructures from first principles. The CSC is shown to strongly depend on the twist angle, with both the spin Hall and standard Rashba-Edelstein efficiencies optimized at or near 30 ​ ° twisting.

arxiv-2212-05248.title: Stochastic Linear-quadratic Control Problems with Affine Constraints Thanks: This work was supported by the National Natural Science Foundation of China (11671282, 12171339) and the grant from Chongqing Technology and Business University (2356004).
arxiv-2212-05248.creator: Zhun Gou, Nan-Jing Huang, Xian-Jun Long, Jian-Hao Kang
arxiv-2212-05248.description: Abstract Abstract. This paper investigates the stochastic linear-quadratic control problems with affine constraints, in which both equality and inequality constraints are involved. With the help of the Pontryagin maximum principle and Lagrangian duality theory, the dual problem of original problem is established and the state feedback form of the solution to the optimal control problem is obtained.

arxiv-2212-14512.title: Matrix-valued Cauchy bi-orthogonal polynomials and a novel noncommutative integrable lattice
arxiv-2212-14512.creator: Shi-Hao Li, Ying Shi, Guo-Fu Yu, Jun-Xiao Zhao
arxiv-2212-14512.description: Abstract . Matrix-valued Cauchy bi-orthogonal polynomials were proposed in this paper, together with its quasideterminant expression. It is shown that the coefficients in four-term recurrence relation for matrix-valued Cauchy bi-orthogonal polynomials should satisfy a novel noncommutative integrable system, whose Lax pair is given by fractional differential operators with non-abelian variables. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification 39A36, 15A15 1.

arxiv-2305-01788.title: Vision Meets Definitions: Unsupervised Visual Word Sense Disambiguation Incorporating Gloss Information
arxiv-2305-01788.creator: Sunjae Kwon 1 , Rishabh Garodia 1 , Minhwa Lee 1 , Zhichao Yang 1 , Hong Yu 1,2,3,4 1 UMass Amherst, 2 UMass Lowell, 3 UMass Chan Medical School, 4 VA Bedford Health Care sunjaekwon@umass.edu, rgarodia@umass.edu, minhwalee@umass.edu zhichaoyang@umass.edu, hong_yu@uml.edu
arxiv-2305-01788.description: Abstract Visual Word Sense Disambiguation (VWSD) is a task to find the image that most accurately depicts the correct sense of the target word for the given context. Previously, image-text matching models often suffered from recognizing polysemous words. This paper introduces an unsupervised VWSD approach that uses gloss information of an external lexical knowledge-base, especially the sense definitions.

arxiv-2306-02492.description: Abstract Most natural language tasks in the radiology domain use language models pre-trained on biomedical corpus. arxiv-2401-02658.creator: Wei Yu, Qingcui Bu, Victor Doroshenko, Lorenzo Ducci, Long Ji, Wenda Zhang, Andrea Santangelo, Shuangnan Zhang, Anand Waghmare, Mingyu Ge, Yue Huang, Hexin Liu, Lian Tao, Zixu Yang, Liang Zhang, Jinlu Qu

arxiv-2402-17974.title: All-heavy pentaquarks
arxiv-2402-17974.creator: Zhi-Biao Liang 1 , Feng-Xiao Liu 2,3 , and Xian-Hui Zhong 1,3
arxiv-2402-17974.description: Abstract In a nonrelativistic potential quark model framework, we carry out a calculation of the mass spectrum for the low-lying 1 ​ S 1S all-heavy pentaquark state by adopting the explicitly correlated Gaussian method. The obtained states are compact and lie far above the lowest dissociation baryon-meson threshold.

arxiv-2512-19505.title: Finite groups and complex projective surfaces
arxiv-2512-19505.creator: Alexander Lubotzky, Matthew Stover
arxiv-2512-19505.description: Abstract In response to a question raised by Belolipetsky and the first author in [ 6 ] , we prove that for every finite group G G there are infinitely many isomorphism classes of compact complex hyperbolic 2 2 -manifolds with automorphism group isomorphic to G G .

pmc-13299315.creator: Qiankun Liu, Mengyuan Zhu, Dongchao Ji, Libo Jiang
pmc-13299315.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). With the rapid advancement and cost reduction in high-throughput sequencing technologies, the accumulation of large-scale, three-dimensional gene expression data has surged. Consequently, effectively reducing the dimensionality of these complex datasets to extract critical biological information remains a significant challenge. Although various methods for identifying gene expression modules have been developed, most do not explicitly account for the multifactorial interactions among the temporal, spatial, and environmental dimensions.
